message.content:
Based on my search, **Procol Harum** was the first to sing "A Whiter Shade of Pale." The song was their debut single, released on **May 12, 1967**, with **Gary Brooker** as the lead vocalist. It became one of the defining songs of the 1967 "Summer of Love" and reached number one in the UK charts in just two weeks.

The original recording featured:
- **Gary Brooker** – piano and lead vocals
- **Matthew Fisher** – Hammond organ (playing the famous Bach-inspired organ line)
- **David Knights** – bass
- **Ray Royer** – guitar
- **Bill Eyden** – session drums

The first cover version by a well-known artist came later in **August 1967**, when **the Everly Brothers** recorded it for their album *The Everly Brothers Sing*.
